comment: * Implementors of this interface can add themselves as update listeners * to an DynamicAnimation instance to receive callbacks on every animation * frame, after the current frame's values have been calculated for that * DynamicAnimation.

methods.name: void onAnimationUpdate(DynamicAnimation animation, float value, float velocity)
methods.comment:
* Notifies the occurrence of another frame of the animation.
         *
         * @param animation animation that the update listener is added to
         * @param value the current value of the animation
         * @param velocity the current velocity of the animation

methodNames: void onAnimationUpdate(DynamicAnimation animation, float value, float velocity)
